stories.title: The latest AI news we announced in September 2026
stories.explanation: Google announced several AI updates from September 2026, including the release of the Gemini 4 Argon model, new Connected Apps in the Gemini App, and WeatherNext 3. These updates enhance AI capabilities for complex problems, voice tools, music generation, and scientific applications.

stories.title: A model guide for the GPT-6 family
stories.explanation: OpenAI released a guide for its GPT-6 models, offering practical tips for startups to choose models, tune reasoning, improve prompts, coordinate tools, and prepare workflows for production. This helps users optimize performance and manage costs with their most advanced model suite.

stories.title: How NVIDIA GPUs Help Accelerate OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast
stories.explanation: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast, running on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, is now available in the OpenAI API and to eligible ChatGPT Work and Codex users. It delivers up to 8x faster token generation than Astra Standard mode, accelerating code generation, tool use, and interactive applications.

stories.title: Anthropic invests $100 million to train 10,000 engineers and tackle the enterprise AI talent gap
stories.explanation: Anthropic is investing $100 million to launch Claude Frontier Academy, aiming to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by the end of 2027. This initiative addresses the enterprise AI talent gap by training engineers to Anthropic's standards, with initial cohorts from major consulting and banking firms.

stories.title: OpenAI’s Dot agent is enterprise software that can also order your dinner
stories.explanation: OpenAI launched Dot, a new consumer AI agent platform aimed at both business use cases and personal tasks. Dots are described as 'cute little guys' that can perform various bidding.

stories.title: NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB Gives Developers More Ways to Build and Scale Local AI
stories.explanation: NVIDIA is releasing DGX Spark 64GB, a new configuration that allows developers to build and scale local AI agents on-device with the full NVIDIA AI stack. This provides a complete local AI platform for agents, inference, fine-tuning, and edge development, with the ability to cluster units for greater performance.

stories.title: Apple says it’s tightening macOS ‘Full Disk Access’ controls due to new risks from AI agents
stories.explanation: Apple is tightening macOS 'Full Disk Access' controls due to new risks posed by increasingly capable AI agents that could access sensitive user data. This policy change aims to enhance user security and privacy.

stories.title: Open-sourcing AstaBrief, the fast report-generation model in Asta
stories.explanation: Ai2 open-sourced AstaBrief, a fast report-generation model designed for scientific work, available on Hugging Face. This allows researchers to generate cited reports faster and verify outputs, addressing specific demands of scientific literature synthesis.

stories.title: Call it AI, call it Super Intelligence, only 2% of consumers are buying it
stories.explanation: The White House is rebranding AI as 'super intelligence' and held an AI safety pledge with major tech CEOs, while Meta and OpenAI are focusing on user-friendly AI products. This reflects a shift in terminology and continued enterprise investment in AI.

stories.title: These AI Experts Want to Do High-Stakes Research Out in the Open
stories.explanation: Trillium Labs, a new nonprofit founded by Nathan Lambert and Tom Zick, aims to conduct high-stakes AI research, including recursive self-improvement and agents, in an open and transparent manner. They plan to publish experimental details to allow for greater scrutiny and community contribution.
